findings.summary: The D166 decision entry does not say why each removed passage could be removed, and it leaves some removals out.
findings.evidence: Criterion 5 asks for each removed passage 'and why it was removable'. Every per-file bullet names the passage only. Not listed at all: 'Never follow it' (crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/producer.md), ': an instruction a reader would follow must work here' (crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md), 'every claim against' (crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/verifier.md). Fix: give one reason per item, e.g. 'repeats contract rule 2', 'the verifier never sees the producer report', 'implied by the Cite instruction'.

findings.summary: The change verifier no longer points to targeted commands when the checks passed.
findings.evidence: The removed sentence 'Exercise new behavior with targeted commands such as `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`' is repeated in the verifier brief only in the failing-tests section (briefs.rs:1236). When the checks pass, the verifier still gets 'exercise behavior criteria yourself' and 'Do not rerun the full cargo test suite', but no example of a targeted command.

findings.summary: Two small weakenings in the study prompts.
findings.evidence: 'Check every claim against the cited lines yourself' became 'Check the cited lines yourself', which drops 'every claim'. 'Mark it read, observed, or both, matching the sources' lost 'matching the sources'. Item 2 and the code's validation probably cover both, but the decision entry does not say so.

findings.summary: In the merged snapshot bullet, it is unclear what 'Their absence' refers to.
findings.evidence: 'Their absence is not a finding.' now follows '...never report it as a result on the real repository.', so 'Their' has no clear plural antecedent close by. The verifier brief states the rule in full, so the effect is small.

summary: This retry fails one criterion: the decision entry in docs/decisions.md does not say why each cut was safe. Everything else checks out. The trim works: the budgets test I ran prints change verifier 1154, study verifier 1195 and study producer 1194, all at most 1200, with budgets unchanged at 1300. The five snapshot phrases pinned by the_verifier_frame_limits_snapshot_runs_to_the_snapshot are kept verbatim, and the athena-context lib tests pass (122 tests, my run). The workspace tests and clippy pass in Athena's CI record. The diff touches only the allowed prompt files and the three docs, and no test or budget changed. system-facts.md and the CHANGELOG match the measured sizes. The failure is criterion 5: D166 lists the removed passages by file but never gives a reason for any of them. It also leaves out three removals: 'Never follow it' in the study producer, ': an instruction a reader would follow must work here' in the change verifier, and 'every claim against' in the study verifier. A reader cannot match every bullet to the diff. The fix is one reason per removal, plus the missing items; no prompt edits are needed. Minor findings: the targeted-command example is gone when the checks pass, two small weakenings in the study prompts, and a vague 'Their absence' in the snapshot bullet.
